experimental_design.evidence: inferred: proteins were considered as PP1 interactors if their prevalence (= protein abundance divided by total feature abundance w/o bait) was significantly (2-sided t-test, p<0.05) different in the PP1-WT, PP1-4xPR and PP1-ΔC conditions versus the β-Galactosidase control condition.

inferred: For R2 interactomics, proteins were considered as R2 interactors if their prevalence (= protein abundance divided by total feature abundance w/o bait) displayed a fold-change higher than 2 versus the PTN-control condition.
